  osup_zero_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST paid on zero-rated supplies (exports under 'with payment' route).

  osup_nil_exmp_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Trade name of the deductee (often blank on older rows).
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank on older TDS rows; see tds_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

The igst_*/cgst_*/sgst_*/cess_* columns break liability into tax/interest/penalty/fee/others. JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`. Contrast with tax_paid_pd_by_cash (actual settlement).
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_pay (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  liab_id (TEXT) -- Liability ID (numeric string). Sequential per liability obligation.
  trancd (TEXT) -- Transaction code. E.g. '30002' (regular tax payment).
  trandate (TEXT) -- Transaction date DD-MM-YYYY.
  igst_tx (NUMERIC) -- IGST tax payable.
  igst_intr (NUMERIC) -- IGST interest payable.
  igst_pen (NUMERIC) -- IGST penalty payable.
  igst_fee (NUMERIC) -- IGST late-filing fee payable.
  igst_oth (NUMERIC) -- IGST others payable.
  cgst_tx (NUMERIC) -- CGST tax payable.
  cgst_intr (NUMERIC) -- CGST interest payable.
  cgst_pen (NUMERIC) -- CGST penalty payable.
  cgst_fee (NUMERIC) -- CGST late-filing fee payable.
  cgst_oth (NUMERIC) -- CGST others payable.
  sgst_tx (NUMERIC) -- SGST tax payable.
  sgst_intr (NUMERIC) -- SGST interest payable.
  sgst_pen (NUMERIC) -- SGST penalty payable.
  sgst_fee (NUMERIC) -- SGST late-filing fee payable.
  sgst_oth (NUMERIC) -- SGST others payable.
  cess_tx (NUMERIC) -- Cess tax payable.
  cess_intr (NUMERIC) -- Cess interest payable.
  cess_pen (NUMERIC) -- Cess penalty payable.
  cess_fee (NUMERIC) -- Cess late-filing fee payable.
  cess_oth (NUMERIC) -- Cess others payable.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.

  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)

  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv — GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).

Table: public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb — MAIN EWB Part-A table. One row per e-way bill. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing consignor/consignee (taxpayer), invoice value, distance, or EWB number. Table: live_reports.r3b_comphrehensive_list_mv_upd1_t_partitioned — GSTR-3B Monthly Summary Return — SINGLE denormalized flat table (a daily-refreshed materialized view), partitioned by fy_flag. One row per (gstin, ret_period) i.e. one filed GSTR-3B return. NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  trdnm (VARCHAR) -- Trade name / Firm name. Free-text — use ILIKE for partial matches.
  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.

  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.
  appr_auth (VARCHAR(20)) -- Approving authority / taxpayer type. 'CENTER' (Central jurisdiction) or 'STATE' (State jurisdiction). When officer asks 'all authorities', use ILIKE 'ALL'.
  fil_dt (DATE) -- Filing date — when the taxpayer filed this return (native DATE). Do NOT cast with TO_DATE.

For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.

ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').

The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  trdnm (VARCHAR) -- Trade name / Firm name. Free-text — use ILIKE for partial matches.
  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.
  status (TEXT) -- Registration status. 'Active', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended'. For active-taxpayer queries use status='Active'.
  rgfmdt (DATE) -- Registration start date (native DATE). E.g. '2017-07-01'.
  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.
  appr_auth (VARCHAR(20)) -- Approving authority / taxpayer type. 'CENTER' (Central jurisdiction) or 'STATE' (State jurisdiction). When officer asks 'all authorities', use ILIKE 'ALL'.
  fil_dt (DATE) -- Filing date — when the taxpayer filed this return (native DATE). Do NOT cast with TO_DATE.
  ret_period (VARCHAR(10)) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. Last 4 chars = CALENDAR year (Jan–Dec), NOT financial year. For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.
  mnth_id (INTEGER) -- Cumulative month counter (chronological grouping across FYs). Increments monthly. Use for ORDER BY on multi-year timelines.
  fy_flag (INTEGER) -- FINANCIAL-year flag (Apr–Mar) AND partition key. 8=FY2024-25, 9=FY2025-26 (full mapping: 1=FY2017-18 … 11=FY2027-28). ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').
  return_from_date (DATE) -- Start DATE of the return period covered (not when filed). E.g. '2024-04-01'.
  return_to_date (DATE) -- End DATE of the return period covered. E.g. '2024-04-30'.
  osup_det_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(a). Total taxable value of regular outward taxable supplies (normal sales, excluding zero/nil/exempt/non-GST).
  osup_det_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state).
  osup_det_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state; equals SGST).
  osup_det_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on regular outward supplies (inter-state). >0 indicates inter-state activity.
  osup_det_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on regular outward supplies.
  osup_zero_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(b). Taxable value of zero-rated supplies (exports + SEZ). Zero-rated supplies get ITC benefit even at 0% output.
  osup_zero_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST paid on zero-rated supplies (exports under 'with payment' route).
  osup_zero_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on zero-rated supplies.
  osup_nil_exmp_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(c). Taxable value of nil-rated and exempt outward supplies (e.g. basic food, education). No GST applies.
  osup_nil_exmp_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on nil-rated/exempt supplies.
  isup_rev_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(d). Taxable value of inward supplies liable to REVERSE CHARGE — the taxpayer (buyer) pays GST on these, not the seller.
  isup_rev_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on RCM inward supplies (inter-state RCM).
  isup_rev_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on RCM inward supplies.
  osup_nongst_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(e). Taxable value of non-GST outward supplies (petrol, diesel, alcohol — outside GST regime). Tax intrinsically 0.
  osup_nongst_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on non-GST supplies.
  itc_avl_impg_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(1). SGST ITC available on imported goods (usually 0 — IGST is relevant for imports).
  itc_avl_impg_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported goods (customs IGST paid at port). >0 for importers.
  itc_avl_impg_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_impg_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_imps_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(2). SGST ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_imps_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported services (RCM on foreign providers).
  itc_avl_imps_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_imps_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_isrc_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(3). SGST ITC available on inward RCM supplies (mirror of isup_rev_samt — claimed back as ITC).
  itc_avl_isrc_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on inward RCM supplies.
  itc_avl_isrc_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on inward RCM supplies.
  itc_avl_isrc_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on inward RCM supplies.
  itc_avl_isd_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(4). SGST ITC available from ISD (Input Service Distributor).
  itc_avl_isd_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available from ISD.
  itc_avl_isd_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available from ISD.
  itc_avl_isd_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available from ISD.
  itc_avl_oth_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(5). SGST ITC available — all other inward supplies (regular domestic purchases). For most taxpayers, the bulk of ITC is here.
  itc_avl_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available — all other (inter-state purchases).
  itc_avl_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available — all other.
  itc_avl_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available — all other.
  itc_rev_rul_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(B)(1). SGST ITC reversed under Rules 38/42/43 + Sec 17(5).
  itc_rev_rul_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reversed (rule-based).
  itc_rev_rul_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC reversed (rule-based).
  itc_rev_rul_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reversed (rule-based).
  itc_rev_oth_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(B)(2). SGST ITC reversed for other reasons.
  itc_rev_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reversed (other).
  itc_rev_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC reversed (other).
  itc_rev_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reversed (other).
  itc_net_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(C). Net SGST ITC available = (4A total) − (4B reversed). Use directly when asked 'net ITC'; do NOT re-derive.
  itc_net_camt (NUMERIC) -- Net CGST ITC available.
  itc_net_iamt (NUMERIC) -- Net IGST ITC available.
  itc_net_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Net Cess ITC available.
  itc_inelg_rul_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(1). CGST ITC reclaim (post-2022-07; pre-2022 these columns held Sec 17(5) ineligible values). Legacy column name.
  itc_inelg_rul_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(2). CGST ineligible ITC under Sec 16(4) / PoS restriction.
  itc_inelg_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  gst_inter (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Inter-State. Value of inter-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.
  gst_intra (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Intra-State. Value of intra-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.
  non_gst_inter (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(2). Value of inter-state NON-GST inward supplies (petrol/alcohol from other states).
  non_gst_intra (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(3). Value of intra-state NON-GST inward supplies.
  itcsetoff_sgst_using_sgst (NUMERIC) -- SGST liability cleared using SGST credit (primary path).
  itcsetoff_sgst_using_igst (NUMERIC) -- SGST liability cleared using IGST credit (when SGST credit insufficient; ADDS to state_income).
  sgst_cashsetoff (NUMERIC) -- SGST liability paid in cash (when ITC insufficient).
  s_intrpd (NUMERIC) -- SGST interest paid in cash (delayed filing).
  s_lfeepd (NUMERIC) -- SGST late fee paid in cash.
  itcsetoff_cgst_using_cgst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using CGST credit.
  itcsetoff_cgst_using_igst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using IGST credit.
  cgst_cashsetoff (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability paid in cash.
  c_intrpd (NUMERIC) -- CGST interest paid in cash.
  c_lfeepd (NUMERIC) -- CGST late fee paid in cash.
  itcsetoff_igst_using_sgst (NUMERIC) -- IGST liability cleared using SGST credit (SUBTRACTS from state_income — SGST outflow).
  itcsetoff_igst_using_cgst (NUMERIC) -- IGST liability cleared using CGST credit.
  itcsetoff_igst_using_igst (NUMERIC) -- IGST liability cleared using IGST credit (primary path for inter-state).
  igst_cashsetoff (NUMERIC) -- IGST liability paid in cash.
  i_intrpd (NUMERIC) -- IGST interest paid in cash.
  i_lfeepd (NUMERIC) -- IGST late fee paid in cash.
  itcsetoff_cess_using_cess (NUMERIC) -- Cess liability cleared using Cess credit (only cross-utilization allowed for cess).
  cs_intrpd (NUMERIC) -- Cess interest paid in cash.
  cs_lfeepd (NUMERIC) -- Cess late fee paid in cash.
  cess_cashsetoff (NUMERIC) -- Cess liability paid in cash.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- TOTAL SGST tax payable this period (rollup of 3.1 outward + 3.1(d) RCM SGST). Shown as 'Tax payable' in Form 6.1. Not to be confused with osup_det_samt (the per-section breakdown).

  igst_cashsetoff_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Form 6.1(B). IGST paid in cash for RCM liability.
  cgst_cashsetoff_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST paid in cash for RCM liability.
  sgst_cashsetoff_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST paid in cash for RCM liability.
  cess_cashsetoff_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess paid in cash for RCM liability.
  i_intrpd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- IGST interest paid in cash for RCM.
  c_intrpd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST interest paid in cash for RCM.
  s_intrpd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST interest paid in cash for RCM.
  cs_intrpd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess interest paid in cash for RCM.
  s_lfeepd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST late fee paid in cash for RCM.
  c_lfeepd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST late fee paid in cash for RCM.
  i_lfeepd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- IGST late fee paid in cash for RCM.
  cs_lfeepd_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess late fee paid in cash for RCM.

  cgst_cashsetoff_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST paid in cash for non-RCM liability.
  sgst_cashsetoff_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST paid in cash for non-RCM liability.
  cess_cashsetoff_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess paid in cash for non-RCM liability.
  i_intrpd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- IGST interest paid in cash for non-RCM.
  c_intrpd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST interest paid in cash for non-RCM.
  s_intrpd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST interest paid in cash for non-RCM.
  cs_intrpd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess interest paid in cash for non-RCM.
  s_lfeepd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- SGST late fee paid in cash for non-RCM.
  c_lfeepd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- CGST late fee paid in cash for non-RCM.
  i_lfeepd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- IGST late fee paid in cash for non-RCM.
  cs_lfeepd_wo_rcm (NUMERIC) -- Cess late fee paid in cash for non-RCM.
  eco_sup_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1.1(i). Taxable value of supplies on which the E-Commerce Operator pays tax (Sec 9(5)). >0 for restaurants on Swiggy/Zomato, cabs on Ola/Uber, etc.

  eco_sup_igst (NUMERIC) -- IGST on ECO-tax supplies.
  eco_sup_cess (NUMERIC) -- Cess on ECO-tax supplies.

  "current_date" (DATE) -- MV refresh stamp — the date this row was last refreshed by the DBA pipeline. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "current_date". NOT the return-period date.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Trade name of the deductee (often blank on older rows).
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank on older TDS rows; see tds_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv — GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (free-form). May be numeric or alphanumeric e.g. 'ME/25-26/464'.
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY.
  ival (NUMERIC) -- Invoice value (gross), NUMERIC.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- Amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST withheld for this invoice.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST withheld.
  flag (TEXT) -- Per-row flag ('N','Y' or blank). Feed-specific meaning.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (TDS parent row). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa_inv — GSTR-7 TDSA invoice-level breakdown. Mirrors tds_inv but carries ORIGINAL (o*) and REVISED columns side by side. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa_inv (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  ogstin_ded (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL deductee GSTIN (often blank).
  omonth (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL period MMYYYY (often blank — carried on the parent tdsa row).
  oamt_ded (NUMERIC) -- ORIGINAL amount deducted on the invoice.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- REVISED deductee GSTIN (often blank when only amount amended).
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- REVISED amount deducted on the invoice.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED IGST withheld for this invoice.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED SGST withheld.
  source (TEXT) -- Source code ('C','D' — feed-specific).
  act_tkn (TEXT) -- Action-taken flag ('Y','N').
  oinum (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice number. E.g. 'TI/25-26/62'.
  oidt (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice date DD-MM-YYYY.
  oival (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice value (stored as TEXT here, unlike tds_inv.ival).
  inum (TEXT) -- REVISED invoice number. Often equals oinum when only amount corrected.
  idt (TEXT) -- REVISED invoice date DD-MM-YYYY.
  ival (TEXT) -- REVISED invoice value (TEXT). Often equals oival when only amount corrected.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa (TDSA parent row). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa — GSTR-7 TDS Amendment data: revisions to TDS rows reported in PRIOR periods. Each row carries BOTH original (o* columns) and revised values. The original period is in omonth (MMYYYY); the amendment itself belongs to the parent tbl_gst_rtn_r7.fp period. Use for 'TDS corrections/amendments' questions. JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  ogstin_ded (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL deductee GSTIN as previously reported. May be empty when only the amount was amended.
  omonth (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL return period being amended, MMYYYY. E.g. '102025'.
  oamt_ded (NUMERIC) -- ORIGINAL amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- REVISED deductee GSTIN (corrected value); or same as ogstin_ded when only the amount changed.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- REVISED amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED IGST withheld.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED SGST withheld.
  source (TEXT) -- Source code of the amendment ('C','D'). Feed-specific; meaning not authoritatively documented.
  act_tkn (TEXT) -- Action-taken flag ('Y','N').
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table (column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`, no `id` prefix — same quirk as TDS table). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Revised deductee trade name (often blank).
  idt (TEXT) -- Revised invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Revised invoice number (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Revised invoice value (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  odeductee_name (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL deductee trade name (often blank).
  oidt (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank).
  oinum (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice number (often blank).
  oival (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice value (often blank).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tax_paid_pd_by_cash — GSTR-7 tax actually PAID via cash ledger — settlement records against liabilities declared in tax_pay. Multiple rows per return (one per debit_id). NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb — MAIN EWB Part-A table. One row per e-way bill. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing consignor/consignee (taxpayer), invoice value, distance, or EWB number. It is the ONLY table holding frgstin, togstin, ewbno. For inter-state movements (frstat <> tostat) IGST applies (igstval nonzero); for intra-state, CGST+SGST apply.
  idtbl_ewb_parta_ewb (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  ewbno (VARCHAR) -- 12-digit E-Way Bill number assigned by NIC portal. Unique. E.g. '392234140001'. Bridges to Part-B via tbl_ewb_partb_ewb.ewb_no.
  ewbdt (VARCHAR) -- EWB generation timestamp, VARCHAR in 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'. E.g. '20/04/2026 11:52:00 PM'. Use TO_TIMESTAMP(ewbdt,'DD/MM/YYYY HH12:MI:SS AM') for date math.

  transtyp (VARCHAR) -- Transaction type code (numeric string). '1'=Regular, '2'=Bill To-Ship To, '3'=Bill From-Dispatch From, '4'=Combination.
  suptype (VARCHAR) -- Supply direction. 'O'=Outward (sale), 'I'=Inward (purchase).
  ssuptyp (VARCHAR) -- Sub-supply type code (numeric string), OFTEN PADDED with trailing spaces e.g. '1  '. TRIM before comparing or use LIKE. '1'=Supply, '8'=Others.
  doctyp (VARCHAR) -- Backing document type. 'INV'=Tax Invoice, 'CHL'=Delivery Challan, 'BIL'=Bill of Supply.
  docno (VARCHAR) -- Source document number (free-form). E.g. 'INV-2627-001'.
  docdt (VARCHAR) -- Source document date, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY'. E.g. '20/04/2026'.

  frname (VARCHAR) -- Consignor trade name.
  frplac (VARCHAR) -- Consignor place — usually city/district, sometimes state name.
  frpin (VARCHAR) -- Consignor PIN code (6 digits).
  frstat (VARCHAR) -- Consignor state code (numeric string). E.g. '6'=Haryana.
  togstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char Consignee (receiver/buyer) GSTIN.
  toname (VARCHAR) -- Consignee trade name.
  toplac (VARCHAR) -- Consignee place.

  sgstval (NUMERIC) -- Total SGST/UTGST on the EWB. ZERO for inter-state movements.

Table: live_reports.r3b_comphrehensive_list_mv_upd1_t_partitioned — GSTR-3B Monthly Summary Return — SINGLE denormalized flat table (a daily-refreshed materialized view), partitioned by fy_flag. One row per (gstin, ret_period) i.e. one filed GSTR-3B return. NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  trdnm (VARCHAR) -- Trade name / Firm name. Free-text — use ILIKE for partial matches.
  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.
  status (TEXT) -- Registration status. 'Active', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended'. For active-taxpayer queries use status='Active'.
  rgfmdt (DATE) -- Registration start date (native DATE). E.g. '2017-07-01'.
  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.
  appr_auth (VARCHAR(20)) -- Approving authority / taxpayer type. 'CENTER' (Central jurisdiction) or 'STATE' (State jurisdiction). When officer asks 'all authorities', use ILIKE 'ALL'.
  fil_dt (DATE) -- Filing date — when the taxpayer filed this return (native DATE). Do NOT cast with TO_DATE.
  ret_period (VARCHAR(10)) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. Last 4 chars = CALENDAR year (Jan–Dec), NOT financial year. For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.
  mnth_id (INTEGER) -- Cumulative month counter (chronological grouping across FYs). Increments monthly. Use for ORDER BY on multi-year timelines.
  fy_flag (INTEGER) -- FINANCIAL-year flag (Apr–Mar) AND partition key. 8=FY2024-25, 9=FY2025-26 (full mapping: 1=FY2017-18 … 11=FY2027-28). ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)

  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

Table: public.tbl_ewb_parta_ewb — MAIN EWB Part-A table. One row per e-way bill. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing consignor/consignee (taxpayer), invoice value, distance, or EWB number. Table: live_reports.r3b_comphrehensive_list_mv_upd1_t_partitioned — GSTR-3B Monthly Summary Return — SINGLE denormalized flat table (a daily-refreshed materialized view), partitioned by fy_flag. One row per (gstin, ret_period) i.e. one filed GSTR-3B return. NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).

  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.

  rgfmdt (DATE) -- Registration start date (native DATE). E.g. '2017-07-01'.
  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.

For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.

ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').

  return_to_date (DATE) -- End DATE of the return period covered. E.g. '2024-04-30'.
  osup_det_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(a). Total taxable value of regular outward taxable supplies (normal sales, excluding zero/nil/exempt/non-GST).

  osup_det_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state; equals SGST).
  osup_det_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on regular outward supplies (inter-state). >0 indicates inter-state activity.
  osup_det_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on regular outward supplies.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.

  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)

  igstval (NUMERIC) -- Total IGST on the EWB. NONZERO for inter-state movements (frstat <> tostat).
  cessval (NUMERIC) -- Total advalorem cess on the EWB. Often 0.
  otherval (NUMERIC) -- Other value (rounding/misc). Often 0.
  status (VARCHAR) -- Current EWB status. 'ACT'=Active, 'CNL'=Cancelled, 'EXP'=Expired. CANONICAL bill state: for 'how many e-way bills were cancelled/expired/active' COUNT bills in THIS table WHERE status='CNL'/'EXP'/'ACT' — do NOT use the Part-B canceldet event log for that count.
  rejstatus (VARCHAR) -- Rejection status flag. Empty/blank when not rejected; non-empty when consignee has rejected the EWB.
  travdist (VARCHAR) -- Travel distance declared in km, stored as STRING. E.g. '232'. Cast to integer for numeric comparison.
  "InvVal" (NUMERIC) -- Invoice value (gross, including tax). CASE-SENSITIVE column name — MUST be referenced with double quotes ("InvVal"), else PostgreSQL folds to lowercase and the column is not found.
  ewbvaliddt (VARCHAR) -- EWB validity expiry timestamp, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.
  vehtype (VARCHAR) -- Vehicle type. 'R'=Regular, 'O'=ODC (Over Dimensional Cargo).
  despfrstat (VARCHAR) -- Dispatched-from state code (numeric). May differ from frstat for Bill-To/Ship-To.
  shiptostat (VARCHAR) -- Ship-to state code (numeric). May differ from tostat for Bill-To/Ship-To.
  idtbl_ewb_parta (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_ewb_parta (Part-A parent batch). (FK -> public.tbl_ewb_parta.idtbl_ewb_parta)
  fraddr (TEXT) -- Consignor full address (free-text).
  toaddr (TEXT) -- Consignee full address (free-text).

Table: live_reports.r3b_comphrehensive_list_mv_upd1_t_partitioned — GSTR-3B Monthly Summary Return — SINGLE denormalized flat table (a daily-refreshed materialized view), partitioned by fy_flag. One row per (gstin, ret_period) i.e. one filed GSTR-3B return. NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  trdnm (VARCHAR) -- Trade name / Firm name. Free-text — use ILIKE for partial matches.
  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.
  status (TEXT) -- Registration status. 'Active', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended'. For active-taxpayer queries use status='Active'.
  rgfmdt (DATE) -- Registration start date (native DATE). E.g. '2017-07-01'.
  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.
  appr_auth (VARCHAR(20)) -- Approving authority / taxpayer type. 'CENTER' (Central jurisdiction) or 'STATE' (State jurisdiction). When officer asks 'all authorities', use ILIKE 'ALL'.
  fil_dt (DATE) -- Filing date — when the taxpayer filed this return (native DATE). Do NOT cast with TO_DATE.
  ret_period (VARCHAR(10)) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. Last 4 chars = CALENDAR year (Jan–Dec), NOT financial year. For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.
  mnth_id (INTEGER) -- Cumulative month counter (chronological grouping across FYs). Increments monthly. Use for ORDER BY on multi-year timelines.
  fy_flag (INTEGER) -- FINANCIAL-year flag (Apr–Mar) AND partition key. 8=FY2024-25, 9=FY2025-26 (full mapping: 1=FY2017-18 … 11=FY2027-28). ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').
  return_from_date (DATE) -- Start DATE of the return period covered (not when filed). E.g. '2024-04-01'.
  return_to_date (DATE) -- End DATE of the return period covered. E.g. '2024-04-30'.
  osup_det_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(a). Total taxable value of regular outward taxable supplies (normal sales, excluding zero/nil/exempt/non-GST).
  osup_det_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state).
  osup_det_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state; equals SGST).
  osup_det_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on regular outward supplies (inter-state). >0 indicates inter-state activity.
  osup_det_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on regular outward supplies.
  osup_zero_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(b). Taxable value of zero-rated supplies (exports + SEZ). Zero-rated supplies get ITC benefit even at 0% output.
  osup_zero_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST paid on zero-rated supplies (exports under 'with payment' route).
  osup_zero_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on zero-rated supplies.
  osup_nil_exmp_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(c). Taxable value of nil-rated and exempt outward supplies (e.g. basic food, education). No GST applies.
  osup_nil_exmp_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on nil-rated/exempt supplies.
  isup_rev_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(d). Taxable value of inward supplies liable to REVERSE CHARGE — the taxpayer (buyer) pays GST on these, not the seller.
  isup_rev_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on RCM inward supplies (inter-state RCM).

  osup_nongst_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(e). Taxable value of non-GST outward supplies (petrol, diesel, alcohol — outside GST regime). Tax intrinsically 0.
  osup_nongst_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on non-GST supplies.
  itc_avl_impg_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(1). SGST ITC available on imported goods (usually 0 — IGST is relevant for imports).
  itc_avl_impg_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported goods (customs IGST paid at port). >0 for importers.
  itc_avl_impg_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_impg_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_imps_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(2). SGST ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_imps_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported services (RCM on foreign providers).
  itc_avl_imps_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported services.

  itc_inelg_rul_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(1). CGST ITC reclaim (post-2022-07; pre-2022 these columns held Sec 17(5) ineligible values). Legacy column name.
  itc_inelg_rul_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(2). CGST ineligible ITC under Sec 16(4) / PoS restriction.
  itc_inelg_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  gst_inter (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Inter-State. Value of inter-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.
  gst_intra (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Intra-State. Value of intra-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.

  itcsetoff_cgst_using_cgst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using CGST credit.
  itcsetoff_cgst_using_igst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using IGST credit.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Trade name of the deductee (often blank on older rows).
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank on older TDS rows; see tds_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv — GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (free-form). May be numeric or alphanumeric e.g. 'ME/25-26/464'.
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY.
  ival (NUMERIC) -- Invoice value (gross), NUMERIC.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- Amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST withheld for this invoice.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST withheld.
  flag (TEXT) -- Per-row flag ('N','Y' or blank). Feed-specific meaning.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (TDS parent row). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa — GSTR-7 TDS Amendment data: revisions to TDS rows reported in PRIOR periods. Each row carries BOTH original (o* columns) and revised values. The original period is in omonth (MMYYYY); the amendment itself belongs to the parent tbl_gst_rtn_r7.fp period. Use for 'TDS corrections/amendments' questions. JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tdsa (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  ogstin_ded (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL deductee GSTIN as previously reported. May be empty when only the amount was amended.
  omonth (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL return period being amended, MMYYYY. E.g. '102025'.
  oamt_ded (NUMERIC) -- ORIGINAL amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- REVISED deductee GSTIN (corrected value); or same as ogstin_ded when only the amount changed.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- REVISED amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED IGST withheld.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- REVISED SGST withheld.
  source (TEXT) -- Source code of the amendment ('C','D'). Feed-specific; meaning not authoritatively documented.
  act_tkn (TEXT) -- Action-taken flag ('Y','N').
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table (column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`, no `id` prefix — same quirk as TDS table). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Revised deductee trade name (often blank).
  idt (TEXT) -- Revised invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Revised invoice number (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Revised invoice value (often blank; see tdsa_inv).
  odeductee_name (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL deductee trade name (often blank).
  oidt (TEXT) -- ORIGINAL invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv — GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.

  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).

  transtyp (VARCHAR) -- Transaction type code (numeric string). '1'=Regular, '2'=Bill To-Ship To, '3'=Bill From-Dispatch From, '4'=Combination.
  suptype (VARCHAR) -- Supply direction. 'O'=Outward (sale), 'I'=Inward (purchase).
  ssuptyp (VARCHAR) -- Sub-supply type code (numeric string), OFTEN PADDED with trailing spaces e.g. '1  '. TRIM before comparing or use LIKE. '1'=Supply, '8'=Others.
  doctyp (VARCHAR) -- Backing document type. 'INV'=Tax Invoice, 'CHL'=Delivery Challan, 'BIL'=Bill of Supply.
  docno (VARCHAR) -- Source document number (free-form). E.g. 'INV-2627-001'.
  docdt (VARCHAR) -- Source document date, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY'. E.g. '20/04/2026'.
  frgstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char Consignor (seller/sender) GSTIN. Use for outgoing-movement queries. Bridges to GSTR-3B/GSTR-7 gstin columns (cross-module).
  frname (VARCHAR) -- Consignor trade name.
  frplac (VARCHAR) -- Consignor place — usually city/district, sometimes state name.
  frpin (VARCHAR) -- Consignor PIN code (6 digits).
  frstat (VARCHAR) -- Consignor state code (numeric string). E.g. '6'=Haryana.
  togstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char Consignee (receiver/buyer) GSTIN.
  toname (VARCHAR) -- Consignee trade name.
  toplac (VARCHAR) -- Consignee place.
  topin (VARCHAR) -- Consignee PIN code.
  tostat (VARCHAR) -- Consignee state code (numeric). E.g. '3'=Punjab.
  assval (NUMERIC) -- Total assessable (taxable) value, pre-tax. E.g. 208700.78.
  cgstval (NUMERIC) -- Total CGST on the EWB. ZERO for inter-state movements (where IGST applies).
  sgstval (NUMERIC) -- Total SGST/UTGST on the EWB. ZERO for inter-state movements.
  igstval (NUMERIC) -- Total IGST on the EWB. NONZERO for inter-state movements (frstat <> tostat).
  cessval (NUMERIC) -- Total advalorem cess on the EWB. Often 0.
  otherval (NUMERIC) -- Other value (rounding/misc). Often 0.
  status (VARCHAR) -- Current EWB status. 'ACT'=Active, 'CNL'=Cancelled, 'EXP'=Expired. CANONICAL bill state: for 'how many e-way bills were cancelled/expired/active' COUNT bills in THIS table WHERE status='CNL'/'EXP'/'ACT' — do NOT use the Part-B canceldet event log for that count.
  rejstatus (VARCHAR) -- Rejection status flag. Empty/blank when not rejected; non-empty when consignee has rejected the EWB.
  travdist (VARCHAR) -- Travel distance declared in km, stored as STRING. E.g. '232'. Cast to integer for numeric comparison.
  "InvVal" (NUMERIC) -- Invoice value (gross, including tax). CASE-SENSITIVE column name — MUST be referenced with double quotes ("InvVal"), else PostgreSQL folds to lowercase and the column is not found.
  ewbvaliddt (VARCHAR) -- EWB validity expiry timestamp, VARCHAR 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM'.
  vehtype (VARCHAR) -- Vehicle type. 'R'=Regular, 'O'=ODC (Over Dimensional Cargo).
  despfrstat (VARCHAR) -- Dispatched-from state code (numeric). May differ from frstat for Bill-To/Ship-To.
  shiptostat (VARCHAR) -- Ship-to state code (numeric). May differ from tostat for Bill-To/Ship-To.
  idtbl_ewb_parta (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_ewb_parta (Part-A parent batch). (FK -> public.tbl_ewb_parta.idtbl_ewb_parta)
  fraddr (TEXT) -- Consignor full address (free-text).
  toaddr (TEXT) -- Consignee full address (free-text).

Table: live_reports.r3b_comphrehensive_list_mv_upd1_t_partitioned — GSTR-3B Monthly Summary Return — SINGLE denormalized flat table (a daily-refreshed materialized view), partitioned by fy_flag. One row per (gstin, ret_period) i.e. one filed GSTR-3B return. NEVER JOIN this table to itself or to any tbl_gst_rtn_r3b base table — all geo, taxpayer-master, supply, ITC, payment, RCM, and ECO fields are on the SAME ROW. The ONLY permitted joins are 1:1 decode lookups to common.mst_fy_years_t (fy_flag) and common.mst_3bd_months_t (ret_period). Tax-component column suffix convention across this table: *_samt=SGST, *_camt=CGST, *_iamt=IGST, *_csamt=Cess. For intra-state, SGST==CGST. ALWAYS add fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is known (prunes the partition scan). For COUNT of taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin); for COUNT of returns use COUNT(*).
  division (VARCHAR(150)) -- Top-level officer jurisdiction. E.g. 'Division 1 (ABD)'.
  "range" (VARCHAR(150)) -- Mid-level officer jurisdiction (under division). E.g. 'Range 1 (ABD)'. RESERVED WORD — MUST be double-quoted as "range".
  unit (VARCHAR(150)) -- Lowest-level officer jurisdiction (under range; aka 'Ghatak'). E.g. 'Ghatak 1 (ABD)'.
  gstin (VARCHAR(30)) -- 15-char Taxpayer GSTIN. First 2 chars = state code. For counting taxpayers use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  trdnm (VARCHAR) -- Trade name / Firm name. Free-text — use ILIKE for partial matches.
  lgnmbzpan (VARCHAR) -- Legal name (per PAN). Often differs from trdnm by branch/city suffix.
  status (TEXT) -- Registration status. 'Active', 'Cancelled', 'Suspended'. For active-taxpayer queries use status='Active'.
  rgfmdt (DATE) -- Registration start date (native DATE). E.g. '2017-07-01'.
  rgtodt (DATE) -- Registration end date (native DATE). NULL for currently-active registrations.
  appr_auth (VARCHAR(20)) -- Approving authority / taxpayer type. 'CENTER' (Central jurisdiction) or 'STATE' (State jurisdiction). When officer asks 'all authorities', use ILIKE 'ALL'.
  fil_dt (DATE) -- Filing date — when the taxpayer filed this return (native DATE). Do NOT cast with TO_DATE.
  ret_period (VARCHAR(10)) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. Last 4 chars = CALENDAR year (Jan–Dec), NOT financial year. For calendar-year filter use ret_period LIKE '%2025'; for month use LIKE '04%'; NEVER use equality for year-only. For financial-year scoping use fy_flag. To display month name/quarter, LEFT JOIN common.mst_3bd_months_t ON ret_period_fl=ret_period.
  mnth_id (INTEGER) -- Cumulative month counter (chronological grouping across FYs). Increments monthly. Use for ORDER BY on multi-year timelines.
  fy_flag (INTEGER) -- FINANCIAL-year flag (Apr–Mar) AND partition key. 8=FY2024-25, 9=FY2025-26 (full mapping: 1=FY2017-18 … 11=FY2027-28). ALWAYS include fy_flag=N in WHERE when a financial year is named. Use in WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY but do NOT project the raw integer — to display the FY, LEFT JOIN common.mst_fy_years_t ON flag_fy=fy_flag and project desc_year (e.g. '2024-25').
  return_from_date (DATE) -- Start DATE of the return period covered (not when filed). E.g. '2024-04-01'.
  return_to_date (DATE) -- End DATE of the return period covered. E.g. '2024-04-30'.
  osup_det_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(a). Total taxable value of regular outward taxable supplies (normal sales, excluding zero/nil/exempt/non-GST).
  osup_det_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state).
  osup_det_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on regular outward supplies (intra-state; equals SGST).
  osup_det_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on regular outward supplies (inter-state). >0 indicates inter-state activity.
  osup_det_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on regular outward supplies.
  osup_zero_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(b). Taxable value of zero-rated supplies (exports + SEZ). Zero-rated supplies get ITC benefit even at 0% output.
  osup_zero_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on zero-rated supplies (usually 0).
  osup_zero_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST paid on zero-rated supplies (exports under 'with payment' route).
  osup_zero_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on zero-rated supplies.
  osup_nil_exmp_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(c). Taxable value of nil-rated and exempt outward supplies (e.g. basic food, education). No GST applies.
  osup_nil_exmp_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on nil-rated/exempt supplies (always 0).
  osup_nil_exmp_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on nil-rated/exempt supplies.
  isup_rev_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(d). Taxable value of inward supplies liable to REVERSE CHARGE — the taxpayer (buyer) pays GST on these, not the seller.
  isup_rev_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on RCM inward supplies (buyer-paid).
  isup_rev_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on RCM inward supplies (inter-state RCM).
  isup_rev_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on RCM inward supplies.
  osup_nongst_txval (NUMERIC) -- Form 3.1(e). Taxable value of non-GST outward supplies (petrol, diesel, alcohol — outside GST regime). Tax intrinsically 0.
  osup_nongst_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST on non-GST supplies (always 0).
  osup_nongst_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess on non-GST supplies.
  itc_avl_impg_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(1). SGST ITC available on imported goods (usually 0 — IGST is relevant for imports).
  itc_avl_impg_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported goods (customs IGST paid at port). >0 for importers.
  itc_avl_impg_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_impg_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on imported goods.
  itc_avl_imps_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(A)(2). SGST ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_imps_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC available on imported services (RCM on foreign providers).
  itc_avl_imps_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC available on imported services.
  itc_avl_imps_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on imported services.

  itc_avl_isrc_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC available on inward RCM supplies.

  itc_rev_rul_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC reversed (rule-based).
  itc_rev_rul_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reversed (rule-based).

  itc_rev_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reversed (other).
  itc_rev_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST ITC reversed (other).
  itc_rev_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reversed (other).
  itc_net_samt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(C). Net SGST ITC available = (4A total) − (4B reversed). Use directly when asked 'net ITC'; do NOT re-derive.

  itc_net_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Net Cess ITC available.
  itc_inelg_rul_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(1). CGST ITC reclaim (post-2022-07; pre-2022 these columns held Sec 17(5) ineligible values). Legacy column name.
  itc_inelg_rul_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_rul_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ITC reclaim (Form 4(D)(1)).
  itc_inelg_oth_camt (NUMERIC) -- Form 4(D)(2). CGST ineligible ITC under Sec 16(4) / PoS restriction.
  itc_inelg_oth_csamt (NUMERIC) -- Cess ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  itc_inelg_oth_iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST ineligible ITC (Form 4(D)(2)).
  gst_inter (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Inter-State. Value of inter-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.
  gst_intra (NUMERIC) -- Form 5(1) Intra-State. Value of intra-state inward supplies from composition/exempt/nil-rated suppliers.

  itcsetoff_cgst_using_cgst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using CGST credit.
  itcsetoff_cgst_using_igst (NUMERIC) -- CGST liability cleared using IGST credit.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST TDS withheld. The reportable TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (SUM these for 'total TDS deducted'), NOT amt_ded.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST TDS withheld. Part of the TDS amount = iamt+camt+samt (not amt_ded).
  tbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- FK to main table tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7. NOTE: the FK column is named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (no `id` prefix) — source-DB quirk. Use this exact name in JOIN ON clauses. (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7)
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ).
  deductee_name (TEXT) -- Trade name of the deductee (often blank on older rows).
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY (often blank on older TDS rows; see tds_inv).
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (often blank; see tds_inv).
  ival (TEXT) -- Invoice value (often blank; see tds_inv).

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv — GSTR-7 TDS invoice-level breakdown: one row per invoice line under a TDS deductee row. JOIN through idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (for the deductee), then to main (for deductor/period).
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds_inv (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  inum (TEXT) -- Invoice number (free-form). May be numeric or alphanumeric e.g. 'ME/25-26/464'.
  idt (TEXT) -- Invoice date DD-MM-YYYY.
  ival (NUMERIC) -- Invoice value (gross), NUMERIC.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- Amount on the invoice on which TDS was deducted.
  iamt (NUMERIC) -- IGST withheld for this invoice.
  camt (NUMERIC) -- CGST withheld.
  samt (NUMERIC) -- SGST withheld.
  flag (TEXT) -- Per-row flag ('N','Y' or blank). Feed-specific meaning.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- FK to tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (TDS parent row). (FK -> public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds.idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds)

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7 — MAIN GSTR-7 (TDS return) table. Filed by DEDUCTORS (govt depts, PSUs, large entities) who withhold GST-TDS from supplier payments. JOIN THIS TABLE for any query needing the deductor's GSTIN or the return period. UNIQUE(gstin, fp). gstin here is the DEDUCTOR (the filer); detail tables carry gstin_ded = the DEDUCTEE. Do NOT conflate the two.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7 (BIGINT) -- Primary key (internal identity). Child tables reference it via a column literally named `tbl_gst_rtn_r7`.
  fp (VARCHAR) -- Return period in MMYYYY format. E.g. '102025'=Oct 2025. Year=last 4 chars, month=first 2. For 'year 2025' use fp LIKE '%2025'; for 'October' use fp LIKE '10%'. NEVER use equality for year-only.
  gstin (VARCHAR) -- 15-char DEDUCTOR GSTIN — the filer of this R7 return. First 2 chars = state code. This column exists ONLY in this main table. For counting deductors use COUNT(DISTINCT gstin).
  fil_dt (VARCHAR) -- Filing date in DD-MM-YYYY format (VARCHAR). E.g. '29-11-2025'. Use TO_DATE(fil_dt,'DD-MM-YYYY') for date math.
  inserted_date (TIMESTAMP) -- Row ingestion timestamp (TIMESTAMPTZ). Operational — usually NOT what users mean by 'filed on'.

Table: public.tbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds — GSTR-7 TDS data: one row per DEDUCTEE per return. The TDS amount withheld = iamt+camt+samt; amt_ded is ONLY the gross pre-TDS payment base, NOT the TDS itself (never SUM amt_ded for a TDS-amount question). JOIN to main via the FK column `tbl_gst_rtn_r7` (note: no `id` prefix) to reach deductor gstin and period. Filter on gstin_ded for 'TDS deducted FROM supplier X'.
  idtbl_gst_rtn_r7_tds (BIGINT) -- Primary key.
  gstin_ded (TEXT) -- 15-char DEDUCTEE GSTIN — the supplier whose payment was subject to TDS. Do NOT confuse with the deductor's gstin in the main table.
  amt_ded (NUMERIC) -- TRAP: this is the BASE amount only — the gross payment on which TDS was computed (pre-TDS) — NOT the TDS. Despite the name 'amt_ded' (amount deducted), do NOT SUM it for 'TDS deducted/withheld/collected'; the TDS amount is iamt+camt+samt.
